svg.aria-label: The four animation frames of Phoenix bird shape type 7, with the character codes listed.
svg.title: The small bird, frame by frame
svg.text: The small bird, frame by frame
Shape type 7 has four frames, each 6 characters wide and two tall.
The four pointers sit consecutively in phoenix_bird_shape_pointers, one stride of two per column apart.
attract_mode.c: drawbirdobject() calls draw_bird_shape_350c() for type 7; width from phoenix_bird_draw_entries[7]
Compare the codes between frames: the wing characters change while the body stays put.
